newsitem.title: USA: Air Express Intl in Korean joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Air Express Intl in Korean joint venture.

text.p: Air Express International Corp said on Wednesday it had entered a joint venture with its long-time South Korea agent, Korea Air Freight Ltd, giving AEI direct control over its operations in the region.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed, but AEI said it would acquire 50 percent of the stock of Korea Air Freight, and that the joint venture company would be named AEI Korea Ltd.
Y.T. Lee, Korea Air Freight's president and principal shareholder, will be president of the the new enterprise, AEI said in a statement.
AEI provides freight transportation and related logistics services in 135 countries.
